displayName: Google & YouTube (Google Merchant Center, Shopping, YouTube Shopping)

sourceAliases.note: No WooCommerce plugin profile authored yet for a Google Shopping feed plugin (e.g. Google Listings & Ads, WooCommerce Google Product Feed); this alias is a forward-pointer for when one is profiled.

preferredWrite.surface: Manual -- no API; merchant connects via Wix dashboard OAuth-style flow to Google Merchant Center

mappingGuidance: This channel is the most automated of the group: after the one-time connect, sync is push-based and continuous — there is no feed link for the merchant to copy anywhere, unlike Meta/TikTok/Pinterest.

evidence.path: wix.stores_channels.actions.v1.marketplace_actions — ConnectExistingAccount/CreateAccount/OnboardingStep/PreOnboardingStep all carry Google-typed request variants (googleAccountConnection, googleOnboardingStep, googlePreOnboardingStep) only; no other marketplace has a typed onboarding variant on this service, confirming Google & YouTube is the one channel with a full Wix-hosted account-connect flow

manualSteps.prerequisite: A Google Merchant Center account (can be created during the connect flow itself).

steps.text: In the Wix dashboard, go to Catalog > Sales Channels > Google & YouTube, and click Get Started.
Choose Sign Up With Wix to create a new Merchant Center account, or connect an existing one (existing accounts must first remove any previously added data feeds).
Complete Google's account verification/consent screen to authorize the connection.
Optional: merchants with a Merchant Center account can additionally connect their YouTube channel from the same dashboard section to tag and display products on videos.

manualSteps.mechanism: Push-based and fully automated after the one-time connect: Wix syncs inventory and pricing to Google continuously via its own Content API / Merchant API gateway. Products then surface across Google Search, Google Shopping, and (if connected) YouTube.
